cues.en: This will be super exciting.
cues.zh: 這會非常精彩。

cues.zh: 我們真的會建立一個深度神經網路，包含神經元，以及連接這些神經元的全連接層。

cues.en: And we will apply all this to a business problem as usual.

cues.zh: 課程已經進行到比較進階的部分，所以這次的資料集也更接近真實情境，有很多觀測值與特徵。

cues.en: And you'll see that we'll actually have to not only use our data pre-processing template, but also use some of the tools of our data pre-processing toolkit.

cues.zh: 其中只有全連接層，不包含卷積層或其他種類的層。

cues.zh: 記得去看看。

cues.zh: 我會想辦法在某處放上連結，讓你也能取得，那門課很不錯。

cues.en: We'll have both cases, you know, the classification case with this course and the regression case with the other free course.
cues.zh: 所以兩種情況都能學到：這門課示範分類，另一門免費課程示範迴歸。

cues.en: All right, so now as usual we're gonna start with Python, and there we go.
cues.zh: 照慣例先從 Python 開始。

cues.en: This folder contains the implementation FirstArtificialNeuralNetwork.ipnyb, which you can either open with Jupyter Notebook or Google Colaboratory.
cues.zh: 這個資料夾包含人工神經網路的 .ipynb 實作檔，可以使用 Jupyter Notebook 或 Google Colaboratory 開啟。

cues.en: And we have of course our data set, which I'm going to explain right now.
cues.zh: 當然也有資料集，現在先來說明。

cues.en: All right, so as you can see, as I told you, it looks indeed more like a real world data set, right?
cues.zh: 如我剛才所說，這次的資料看起來確實更貼近真實情境。

cues.en: For the first time, our data set takes the full screen here, because, indeed, this time we have many features, you know, starting from here up to this one and the dependent variable right here.
cues.zh: 這是第一次資料集佔滿整個畫面，因為這次特徵很多，從這個欄位到這裡，最後一欄是應變數。

cues.en: All right, so let me explain what this is about.
cues.zh: 先說明這個資料集的背景。

cues.en: This is the data set of a bank which collected some informations about their customers.
cues.zh: 這是一家銀行蒐集的客戶資訊。

cues.en: These informations are, well, row number, that's just a non-relevant feature.
cues.zh: 例如 RowNumber，只是列編號，並不是相關的特徵。

cues.en: We will get rid of it.
cues.zh: 我們會把它移除。

cues.en: Then the customer ID, that's just the identification key of each customer, the surname, the credit score, the geography, meaning the country the customer lives in,
cues.zh: 接著是 CustomerId，也就是每位客戶的識別鍵；還有姓氏、信用評分、所在地，也就是居住國家，

cues.en: the gender, the age, the tenure, meaning the number of years they have been in the bank, the balance, meaning the amount of money they have on their account,
cues.zh: 性別、年齡、往來年資，也就是成為銀行客戶的年數，以及餘額，也就是帳戶中的金額，

cues.en: the number of products they use from the bank, you know, like a credit card or a checkbook or a MasterCard or even a loan or home loan, you know, any banking products, okay,
cues.zh: 還有使用的銀行產品數，例如信用卡、支票簿、MasterCard，甚至貸款或房貸等各種銀行產品。

cues.en: so that's the number of perks each customer has.
cues.zh: 這就是每位客戶使用的產品數。

cues.en: Then, has credit card, yes or no, meaning that this variable is equal to one if the customer has a credit card and zero otherwise.
cues.zh: 接著 HasCrCard 代表有沒有信用卡，有的話是 1，否則是 0。

cues.en: Is active member, meaning, is the customer active?
cues.zh: IsActiveMember 表示客戶是否活躍。

cues.en: Is he or she using the bank, you know, connecting to its account or using its credit card or any other card?
cues.zh: 是否使用銀行服務，例如登入帳戶、使用信用卡或其他卡片。

cues.en: Let's say they have some measurement system to measure if a customer is active or not.
cues.zh: 假設銀行有一套衡量系統，判定客戶是否活躍。

cues.en: And one means, of course, that the customer is active and zero means that it is unactive, okay?
cues.zh: 1 當然代表活躍，0 代表不活躍。

cues.en: Then estimated salary, well, the salary of the customer estimated by the bank, and that's it, that's the last feature.
cues.zh: 再來是 EstimatedSalary，也就是銀行估計的客戶薪資，這是最後一個特徵。

cues.en: And then the last column here, exited is the dependent variable, and it tells if, yes or no, well, the customer stayed in the bank or left the bank.
cues.zh: 最後的 Exited 欄位是應變數，表示客戶究竟留下，還是離開銀行。

cues.en: One means that it left the bank, as in exited equals yes.
cues.zh: 1 代表離開，也就是 Exited 為是。

cues.en: And zero means that the customer stayed in the bank, as in exited equals no.
cues.zh: 0 代表留下，也就是 Exited 為否。

cues.en: So what happened in reality is that this bank actually observed their customers for a certain period of time, let's say six months.
cues.zh: 實際情境是，銀行觀察客戶一段時間，例如六個月。

cues.en: They observed if during the six months they left the bank or stayed in the bank and they gathered these outcomes in this last dependent variable.
cues.zh: 觀察客戶在六個月內離開或留下，再將結果記錄於最後的應變數欄位。

cues.en: And at the same time, you know, they got all these features, well, to guess what, understand the correlations between these features
cues.zh: 同時也取得這些特徵，目的就是了解各個特徵

cues.en: and the fact whether or not the customer stays in the bank or leaves the bank.
cues.zh: 與客戶留下或離開之間的關聯。

cues.en: And that makes sense, right?
cues.zh: 這很合理，對吧？

cues.en: Because a bank wants to have the maximum customers, right?
cues.zh: 因為銀行希望擁有越多客戶越好。

cues.en: That's how they make money.
cues.zh: 這就是他們賺錢的方式。

cues.en: The more customers they have, the more they have money in the bank, and the more they make money from the diverse products they offer to their customers.
cues.zh: 客戶越多，銀行裡的資金越多，也能透過提供給客戶的各種產品賺取更多收入。

cues.en: So, of course, their interest is to keep the maximum customers, and therefore they made this data set to understand the reason somehow
cues.zh: 所以他們希望盡量留住客戶，並建立這份資料集，試著了解

cues.en: why customers leave the bank.
cues.zh: 客戶為什麼離開。

cues.en: And mostly, once they managed to build a predictive model that can predict if any new customer leaves the bank, model that was trained, of course, on this data set,
cues.zh: 更重要的是，一旦用這份資料訓練出能預測新客戶是否會離開的模型，

cues.en: well, they will deploy this model on new customers.
cues.zh: 就能把模型部署到新客戶資料上。

cues.en: And for all the customers where the model predicts that the customer leaves the bank, well, they will be prepared and they might do some special offer
cues.zh: 如果模型預測某位客戶會離開，他們就能提前準備，甚至提供一些優惠，

cues.en: to the customer so that it will stay in the bank, you see?
cues.zh: 讓客戶願意留下。

cues.en: So all this is to prevent the maximum customers from leaving the bank.
cues.zh: 這一切就是為了盡可能降低客戶流失。

cues.en: And why is this called churn modeling?
cues.zh: 為什麼叫 churn modeling？

cues.en: Because customer churn means exactly the situation where some customers exit, you know, become no longer customer, all right?
cues.zh: 因為 customer churn 正是客戶離開、不再使用服務的情況。

cues.en: And of course the bank has asked you, the most talented data scientist, to make this predictive model, to first train it on this data set to understand the correlations of all these features
cues.zh: 銀行當然請你這位最優秀的資料科學家來建立預測模型，先用這份資料訓練，了解所有特徵

cues.en: and the dependent variable, and then to deploy this model on future customers.
cues.zh: 與應變數的關聯，再把模型部署到未來的客戶資料。

cues.en: And you will see that in the implementation, we will actually deploy the future machine learning model will get on a different customer, you know, not part of this data set, so as to predict if this new customer
cues.zh: 你會看到，實作時也會把訓練好的機器學習模型，實際用在不屬於這份資料集的另一位客戶身上，預測新客戶

cues.en: will stay in the bank or leaves the bank.
cues.zh: 會留下還是離開。

cues.en: And even better than this, we will actually predict the probability that this customer leaves the bank.
cues.zh: 更進一步，還會預測這位客戶離開銀行的機率。

cues.en: So we have a lot to do ahead of us, but I'm super excited, because deep learning is a fascinating branch of machine learning.
cues.zh: 後面有很多工作，但我非常期待，因為深度學習是機器學習中很迷人的分支。

cues.en: So let's start right away and let's open our implementation, ArtificialNeuralNetwork.ipynb, which you can feel free to open with either Google Colaboratory,

cues.zh: 只要在自己喜歡、使用起來自在的 IDE 裡寫程式即可。

cues.zh: 實作檔正在開啟，Notebook 載入完成，很好。

cues.zh: 這就是實作內容，同樣處於唯讀模式。

cues.zh: 照慣例，會從零重新實作，透過動手做來真正學會。

cues.zh: 現在移除所有儲存格。

cues.zh: 我把實作細節都列出來，所以會看到很多步驟。

cues.en: We start first by importing the libraries as usual and then we enter Part One, data pre-processing.

cues.zh: 這是整份實作的第一部分；完整結構分為四部分，分別是第一部分資料前處理、第二部分建立 ANN，

cues.zh: 第三部分訓練 ANN，以及第四部分預測與評估模型。

cues.en: And then in each part, well, we have the different steps.
cues.zh: 每一部分又分成不同步驟。

cues.en: In Part One, data pre-processing, we will first import the data set, of course.
cues.zh: 第一部分資料前處理，當然先匯入資料集。

cues.en: Then we'll have some data pre-processing to do, you know, not only the classic steps of the template, but also some extra tools, and we will see that together.
cues.zh: 接著進行前處理，不只有範本裡的經典步驟，也有額外工具，會一起來看。

cues.en: Then in Part Two, we will first initialize the A and N.
cues.zh: 第二部分先初始化 ANN。

cues.en: We will add an input layer and the first hidden layer to our artificial brain.
cues.zh: 為人工大腦加入輸入層和第一個隱藏層。

cues.en: Then we'll add the second hidden layer, then the output layer.
cues.zh: 再加入第二個隱藏層，以及輸出層。

cues.en: Then in the next Part Three, training the A and N, we will first start by compiling the A and N to an optimizer and a loss function.
cues.zh: 第三部分訓練 ANN，先編譯模型，指定最佳化器和損失函數。

cues.en: Then we will train the A and N on the training set.
cues.zh: 接著用訓練集訓練 ANN。

cues.en: And finally, in Part Four, well, we will deploy our model in production to predict the result of a single observation, meaning to predict if a new customer
cues.zh: 最後在第四部分，將模型用於實際情境，預測單一觀測值，也就是判斷新客戶

cues.en: will stay or leave the bank.
cues.zh: 會留下還是離開銀行。

cues.en: Then we will predict the test set results to, you know, get that y_predict vector to eventually make the confusion matrix with the final accuracy.
cues.zh: 再預測測試集，取得 y_pred 向量，最後建立混淆矩陣並計算準確率。
